desc: Derive the fixed-center retained size: with common leaf count `y>=1`, all neighbors of center having capacity `deg(v)-1>=y` may be intermediates, retaining `1+x(y+1)` vertices.
Determine directed-edge capacity: when `c` is center and adjacent `v` is intermediate, `v` can provide up to `deg(v)-1` leaves.
Prove optimality is captured by selecting an original vertex as center and deleting every unselected adjacent/excess structure.
Choose efficient aggregation: sort each center’s neighbor capacities descending and evaluate only complete equal-capacity groups.
Implement the algorithm in Python with correct grouped processing and `x,y >= 1` handling.
